finish_gate.counterfactual_limit: Actual new teacher inference uses RPC wall timings. Compare first rendered frame, settled q/TCP/aperture, first inference observation tensors/timestamps, delivered plans/accepted commands and first divergence before candidate FINISH. Same seed is not proof of an identical pre-effect trajectory.
finish_gate.every_observer_finish_required: EVERY observed candidate observer FINISH must have valid causal acknowledged/measured opening and fresh post-ACK bilateral unloaded dwell, followed by the complete 2 s hold without new robot/environment collision, safety stop, renewed bilateral grip load, independently scored drop, mechanical invalidity or missing hold evidence. Any provenance or physical-hold failure blocks qualification even when another candidate produces a clean positive. Lack of independent supported placement alone remains a task failure; at least one independently supported candidate placement is required overall.
finish_gate.interpretation: This is a small integration gate, not an estimated robust success rate. Report all8cases; any technical invalidity stops the remainder and blocks qualification. Physical failures continue.
finish_gate.negative_required: No candidate observer FINISH without a preceding played acknowledged measured opening and fresh post-ACK bilateral unloaded dwell. A controller FINISH without independent placement is retained as failed task, never converted to success.
finish_gate.positive_required: At least one candidate unlatched observer FINISH, independent supported placement, and a clean full2s post-FINISH hold without safety stop, robot/environment collision under frozen criteria, renewed bilateral grip load, drop or mechanical invalidity. Normal packet support contact is required by the independent scorer, not a collision failure.
